event_name: Date 06 September 2020 Time 16:46 2020 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 3 - 6 September 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Driving unnecessarily slowly from prior to turn 11 to the pit lane.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 39.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards viewed video evidence and GPS data and it was apparent that car 31 maintained a reasonable time delta to the car in front and behind.
rules_referenced: Article 39.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 31 Alleged Driving Unnecessarily Slowly
